mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK (message_id, conversation_id, user_idx, anon_session_id, url, label, ip_address) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{userIdx}, #{anonSessionId}, #{url}, #{label}, #{ipAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(clicked_at) AS clickDate, COUNT(*) AS clickCount FROM CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK WHERE clicked_at >= #{from} AND clicked_at < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(clicked_at) ORDER BY clickDate ASC

SELECT click_id, message_id, conversation_id, user_idx, anon_session_id, url, label, ip_address, clicked_at FROM CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK WHERE ip_address = #{ip} AND (user_idx = #{userIdx} OR user_idx IS NULL) ORDER BY clicked_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT click_id, message_id, conversation_id, user_idx, anon_session_id, url, label, ip_address, clicked_at FROM CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY clicked_at ASC

SELECT c.click_id AS clickId, c.message_id AS messageId, c.conversation_id AS conversationId, c.user_idx AS userIdx, u.nickname AS nickname, c.anon_session_id AS anonSessionId, c.ip_address AS ipAddress, c.clicked_at AS clickedAt FROM CHATBOT_LINK_CLICK c LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = c.user_idx WHERE c.url = #{url} ORDER BY c.clicked_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
